OUR STORY

Born from love,
for Ayushman

"Ayushman — whose name means 'blessed with long life' — is a child who sees the world in vivid, beautiful ways that others often miss."

His journey with autism inspired his family to build something bigger: a foundation that ensures no child ever feels unseen. What began as a father's love letter to his son has grown into a community united by one belief — every child deserves to shine.

We know firsthand the weight of navigating therapy costs, school rejections, and isolation. That's exactly why Ayushman Foundation exists — so no family has to carry that weight alone.

Support us today →

WHAT WE DO

What we do right now

We are honest — we are just starting out. Today we entirely focus on ensuring no special child misses care because of money.

🧠

Therapy Costs

We cover speech, occupational and behavioural therapy sessions for families who cannot afford them.

Learn more →
🎒

Schooling & Fees

School fees, admission support, and learning materials — so no child misses out on education.

Learn more →
👕

Uniforms & Essentials

We ensure every child is dressed with dignity — uniforms, clothing, and basic daily essentials.

Learn more →
🥗

Food & Nutrition

Supporting centres and families with nutritious meals so children can learn and grow.

Learn more →
🎨

Engagements

Small-scale activities that keep special-abled children engaged, learning and thriving.

Learn more →
💛

Direct Family Help

Sometimes a family just needs a hand. We provide direct support to those going through a hard time.

Learn more →

TRANSPARENCY

Where your money goes

We believe in complete transparency. Every rupee donated is accounted for and directed to where it matters most.
